top_signals.title: ‘Shiranui’: A maritime mirage inspires an anime about morality
top_signals.summary: Director Ryo Katanosaka pivoted to animation during the COVID-19 pandemic, producing a two-minute short that paved the way for "Shiranui."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ‘Masayume’ finds Zen in the messiness of being human
top_signals.summary: Nao Yoshigai's experimental documentary blends meditation, autobiography and bodily humor into an unconventional meditation on healing and acceptance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
